diagnostic_contract.ranking: Complete closed approval day; score descending then order_id ascending; floor(0.1*N), unknown outcomes compete before masks.
diagnostic_contract.historical_outcome: Actual delivery strictly before the original fold evaluation-start cutoff; evaluation rows are already inspected development retests.
diagnostic_contract.phase_scope: All 12 original phases per seed; repeated historical months remain separate. Only the three disjoint development months may be pooled within each seed.
diagnostic_contract.route_scope: All observed true state routes, missing route as unknown; no subgroup reranking or quotas.
diagnostic_contract.cell_order: R,P,A; eight disjoint cells000..111; missing age has A=false, not necessarily the only reason.
diagnostic_contract.finer_age_scope: Cell110 in every seed and phase
per_seed_phase: Newly lost and recovered delays relative to the same-seed101
Every true route, eight RPA cells, overlapping RPA marginals and five finer110 age bins
Daily gross changed slots, within/cross true-route and RPA-cell exchanges; monthly totals sum daily flows
Newly lost delay full-day rank bins and capacity gaps1-3/4-10/11+

cross_seed_summary.pairing: Compute age102 minus101 inside each seed before summarizing; never subtract marginal extrema.
cross_seed_summary.denominators: Same phase/group identities, known masks and delayed denominators across all five seeds; average per-seed results, not five independent populations.
cross_seed_summary.undefined: Zero-denominator rates stay null; record defined/undefined seed counts, never replace by zero.

lost_identity_overlap.definition: Known delayed, same-seed101 alerted and same-seedage102 missed. Each seed has its own paired reference101.
lost_identity_overlap.all_phases: ALL newly lost sets in each of12 phases
lost_identity_overlap.february_focus: ALL/R/P/A/RP/RA/PA/RPA, every disjoint cell and each finer110 age bin
summaries: Known delayed orders never newly lost by any seed
lost_identity_overlap.empty_union: Jaccard null when both pairwise sets are empty.
lost_identity_overlap.privacy: Order identities used internally only; publish aggregate overlap counts, never order lists or identity hashes.

diagnostic_contract.seed42_reference: Verify saved scores and complete-day alerts against the frozen original age experiment and preceding intersection counts.
prohibitions: No fit, model deserialization, saved-model replay, calibration or selection in diagnosis
No best-seed choice, February-based model selection or new subgroup quota
No original holdout scoring; seed repeats on the same data are not independent test samples
No causal claim that sampling explains a regression

policies.training: Eight identical mature deadline_wait0 train/scoring cohorts, stable approval-time/ID order and daily queries for both packages and all five seeds.
policies.fit: Fresh refit for both packages at all five seeds, including42; no eval set, early stopping, parameter/window/support/feature search.
policies.preprocessing: Original train-only median imputation/add_indicator and OHE rules; only age102 has the one original age input, never pending count or a manual indicator.
policies.ranking: Complete closed daily floor(0.1*N) batch before known-label masks; unknowns compete, no group quotas or carryover.
policies.seed42: New seed42 fits must reproduce original frozen scores to rtol0/atol1e-12 and exact complete-day alert decisions.
policies.statistics: First compute age102 minus101 within each seed, then mean/min/max and negative/zero/positive/undefined counts. Do not subtract model marginal ranges or pool seed repetitions as independent orders.
policies.selection: No best seed, no new historical model selection or new candidate registry, no February-driven choice; original80-candidate research primary remains frozen.
policies.data_role: All historical phases and three development months are already inspected; seed repeats are not independent new data or unknown-test gains.
policies.holdout: Original retained period not scored, no new features after the original pre-May cutoff.
policies.preservation: Original16 monthly and3 selected artifacts only hashed, never loaded or overwritten; outputs only in Git-ignored paths; unchanged research/default models.
policies.reuse: Explicit own-version reuse only with identical specification, seed, source, feature whitelist and training layout; a reused version is not a new fit in that execution.
